name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Partner Onboarding & Experience Leader | Funnel Metrics, Automation & Team Leadership
summary: Onboarding and partner-experience leader with 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and agency operations. Led a team of 20 (later 8) onboarding specialists at Wix while launching 25+ clients a month, and onboarded 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye with ~94% retention. At Solenzo I build the full funnel for home-services businesses: paid acquisition, capture, qualification, scheduling with automated reminders, no-show recovery, and reactivation, measured stage by stage. That is the same machinery that moves an applicant to a first shift and keeps them coming back.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected a 20+ workflow automation system in GoHighLevel spanning lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, and long-term reactivation.

Build dashboards tracking lead volume, conversion by funnel stage, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, using GA4, CRM analytics, and SQL, and report findings and recommendations to business owners on a regular cadence.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account to cut spam and low-quality leads, then traced the remaining drop-off to on-site conversion, fixing the real bottleneck instead of adding spend.
Build marketing-automation workflows for home-services trade businesses (electrical, plumbing, HVAC), fluent in how local service operations fill schedules and lose customers.
Design evaluation loops that monitor automation and AI output against defined standards, catching broken steps before they cost a lead.
Run a free audit offer as a top-of-funnel acquisition play: 180+ businesses enrolled, 2 converted to paying clients.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Advised client businesses on ad-spend budget planning and allocation across paid campaigns.
Built campaign reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and turned the data into optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Produced conversion-focused landing pages and multi-touch email sequences that improved lead generation.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Built automated product-training and communication sequences that reduced onboarding friction across the partner network.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to find adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Fed structured, prioritized partner feedback to Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Led the sales team while carrying my own accounts, and rebuilt internal processes to improve reporting accuracy and reduce handoff errors.
Analyzed paid media and creative performance and translated results into optimization recommendations.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), setting priorities and overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

Drove team initiatives for a new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, including hiring, onboarding, and training new hires and building sales training for tenured reps.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute.
